Allows you to change the [b]day/season/year[/b] at will. Also includes an option to freeze time.

It applies the [b]next morning[/b] after you go to sleep.

There is an option in GMCM to apply immediately and is turned off by default as it can [i]possibly cause problems[/i].

This does trigger events as normal.

It is also compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url].

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]

Manifest.Name: Date Change
Manifest.Description: In-game menu to change day, season, and year, plus freeze time. Defaults to queuing date changes for the next morning; optional GMCM setting enables immediate apply.
